title: Prove exact sign-dependent tariffs for every signed 3x3 connector target
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact sign-dependent query tariff for every one of the 19,683 signed 3x3 dirty-connector targets, over every nonzero unital coefficient ring. This answers #4241 open question 1 and combines its canonical envelope with #944's support-attaining class. Claim type: **scoped proof with finite corroboration**. No new κ.

```text
S(M) = active source/output operators
sigma_F = p_F^+ + p_F^-; mu_F = min(p_F^+, p_F^-)
c = 0:  b_F = sigma_F,             u_F = 2 sigma_F
c >= 2: b_F = min(sigma_F,c mu_F),  u_F = min(2 sigma_F,c mu_F)
minimum(M) = sum_S b_F + delta(M) min_S(u_F-b_F)
delta(M) = 1 on the 288-member signed/permuted obstruction orbit
minimum(0) = 0
```

The new proof transports all valid words and their actual sign prices through signed row/column permutations. The two price statistics survive sign swaps, so the canonical formula extends to the entire orbit. Outside the orbit, independent cheaper-sign conversions of the support-attaining words attain sum b. The constructor emits the word at its actual fixed ports; no physical permutation or frame change is treated as free.

Only `research/signed-matrix-price-classification/` is added. Produced by Nick Petalas. Predecessor credit: Ross Richardson's #944/#943/#934 and their PR889/PR628 lineage, martinxxx9's #1088 repairs, Sagar Thakrar's #1349, and #4233/#4241. Their results are used as lemmas, not independently audited here.

## Evidence

Before, #4241 covered only the canonical target. After, the written proof and constructor cover the full target domain. The registered normal and optimized scientific checks each pass with:

- 472,392 priced words: all 19,683 targets, six characteristics and four price vectors;
- 27,648 transported anchors, covering every orbit target and operator, eight characteristics and both global signs;
- 6,912 rational-price orbit words, 768 count-profile DPs, 2,304 noncommuting dense dirty-array executions and 744 query-deletion controls.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/signed-matrix-price-classification/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/signed-matrix-price-classification/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/signed-matrix-price-classification
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/signed-matrix-price-classification --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_SIGNED_MATRIX_PRICE_CLASSIFICATION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local interpreter path. Standard library only. Timed scientific runs took 18.45 and 20.18 seconds locally on CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64, below their individual 180-second limits. These are check durations, not performance comparisons. Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass. Optimized Git-free replay passes on a read-only committed export; all seven payload files remain unchanged. A modified predecessor input is rejected at its SHA256 pin. Normal, optimized and exported source-bound receipt digests agree: `abe049c995ebac53d97a670ad31f420e04548b13fba6c26508e83d6d44b6a8f9`. Each scientific run generates a receipt bound to all package and live-input hashes; use `--receipt /path/outside` to save its JSON outside the checkout.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The all-ring theorem is a written proof using #944's finite integer classification and the unmerged canonical theorem #4241 at `ec573175d36cb016661f37293dd9ee2aefb737bb`. This does not independently establish those lemmas. Finite price/characteristic checks corroborate the proof, rather than enumerate every ring or price. Both live certificate inputs are pinned to main; no pending executable or Git object is required by replay. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No physical caller, instantiated complete prices, routing/admission, precision, supplier integration or outer multiplication theorem is supplied. No selected cold replay or formal build was run.

## Open next questions

1. Bind one real caller, its demand matrix and actual forward/inverse complete prices, then compare routing, admission and total schedules.
2. Find a signed 3x4 support obstruction with both an arbitrary-operator integer repair and finite-characteristic unary anchors. Without those attainment properties the same lower bound need not be sharp.

## Related open work

- #4241, head `ec573175d36cb016661f37293dd9ee2aefb737bb`, supplies the canonical sign-dependent theorem and anchors; this extends its target domain. At forward/inverse prices (1,3), the canonical bills 28,18,24,25,28 in characteristics 0,3,4,5,8 agree, checked numerically.
- #4233, head `d56d43c726dddc37a97a5dabf9d13ef861394133`, supplies the canonical equal-sign characteristic law through #4241. Unit-price bills 14,12,13,14,14,14 in characteristics 0,2,3,4,5,8 agree, checked numerically.

Live claims and open PRs, main README searches and merged-PR searches were checked before claiming and before committing. The overlap helper's complete snapshot covered 364 open PRs and 3,135 Discussion records; this is evidence of search coverage, not a novelty certificate. Main remained `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7.

Planning passed in 2m55s and the package replay in 1m40s. Both hosted scientific modes printed the local counts and receipt digest `abe049c995ebac53d97a670ad31f420e04548b13fba6c26508e83d6d44b6a8f9`; `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and the unchanged-input step passed. No check failed. All registered commands and source checks passed locally; there is no unrun registered local obligation assigned to CI.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. The change adds one research package and its explicit replay manifest.
